import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Use top features based on t-statistics
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        t_stat = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i]).statistic)
        t_stats.append(t_stat)
    
    # Sort by t-statistic and get top 10
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:10]
    candidates = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    keep = []
    for fid in candidates:
        is_duplicate = False
        for kept_fid in keep:
            col_a = feats.column(fid)
            col_b = feats.column(kept_fid)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_a], feats.x[:, col_b])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            keep.append(fid)
    
    # Limit to 4 drivers as per checker feedback
    drivers = keep[:4]
    
    # Simple model with minimal terms
    columns = tuple(keep[:4])  # Use only top 4 features
    products = ()
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in keep[:4]}
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
